title: Phytochemical Evaluation and Antioxidant Potential of Polyherbal Extract Mixture-an In Vitro and In Silico Study.
authors: Veeraswamy, Sharmila Devi; Raju, Ilavarasan; Mohan, Sumithra
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估多草药制剂的植物化学与抗氧化活性，分子对接仅针对Keap1/Nrf2蛋白与小分子，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Standardisation of polyherbal formulations plays a key role in estimating the quality and safety of drugs. In this study, a novel polyherbal formulation was prepared for the treatment of diabetic nephropathy and it was attempted to evaluate for its safety and efficacy against free radicals. To ascertain the safety of the formulation, individual herbs and polyherbal formulation have been screened for microbial load, heavy metals, pesticide residues and aflatoxins according to Ayush guidelines. Phytochemical analysis was carried out using standard procedures and GCMS analysis to identify the bioactive compounds. Antioxidant methods such as DPPH, nitric oxide, hydrogen peroxide, hydroxyl and superoxide radical scavenging assays were undertaken. To predict the mechanism behind the antioxidant efficacy, a molecular docking analysis was performed against Keap1/Nrf2 (PDB ID: 2FLU) protein using AutoDock Vina software. Phytochemical analysis showed the presence of alkaloids, tannins, flavones, glycosides, polyphenols, phytosterols and saponins. The results of in vitro antioxidant studies showed increase in percentage inhibition with increase in concentration and found no significant difference compare with standards. Among the 15 bioactive compounds identified from GCMS analysis, guanosine showed high binding affinity with Keap1/Nrf2 and interacting with similar residues as that of standard ascorbic acid which is analysed through molecular docking. Based on the results, it has been concluded that the safety parameters of polyherbal formulation were found within specified limits of Ayush guidelines and its efficacy against oxidative stress plays an effective role to treat diabetic nephropathy due to its synergistic antioxidant effect.
abstract_zh: 多草药制剂（polyherbal formulations）的标准化在评估药物质量和安全性方面起着关键作用。本研究制备了一种用于治疗糖尿病肾病的新型多草药制剂，并尝试评估其针对自由基的安全性和有效性。为确保制剂安全性，根据Ayush指南，对单味草药和多草药制剂进行了微生物负荷、重金属、农药残留和黄曲霉毒素的筛查。采用标准程序进行植物化学分析，并通过GCMS分析鉴定生物活性化合物。进行了抗氧化方法，如DPPH、一氧化氮、过氧化氢、羟基和超氧化物自由基清除试验。为预测抗氧化功效背后的机制，使用AutoDock Vina软件对Keap1/Nrf2（PDB ID: 2FLU）蛋白进行了分子对接分析。植物化学分析显示存在生物碱、鞣质、黄酮、糖苷、多酚、植物甾醇和皂苷。体外抗氧化研究结果表明，随着浓度增加，抑制百分比增加，且与标准品相比无显著差异。在GCMS分析鉴定的15种生物活性化合物中，鸟苷（guanosine）与Keap1/Nrf2表现出高结合亲和力，并与标准抗坏血酸相似的残基相互作用，这一点通过分子对接分析得出。基于这些结果，得出结论：多草药制剂的安全参数在Ayush指南规定范围内，其对氧化应激的功效通过协同抗氧化作用在治疗糖尿病肾病中发挥有效作用。
